acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass talks about a recent experience being interviewed and the realization that he was being asked about another version of himself.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Reporter Evan Ratliff creates an AI version of himself and then sets it loose on the world. This story was adapted from Evan's podcast, Shell Game.
acts.credits: By Evan Ratliff; Produced by David Kestenbaum
acts.title: Me and My Shadow

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Emmanuel Dzotsi explores the phenomenon of people lying on first dates to project a better version of themselves. Plus, he gets into a very personal example from his own life.
acts.title: Papa Was a Trolling Stone
